declarations.docstring: For a commutative algebra of finite type over the integers, the full subcategory of finitely generated modules admits an abelian category structure.
The zero module is finitely generated over any commutative ring.
Finite products of finitely generated modules over a commutative ring are finitely generated.
Every quotient of a finitely generated module over a commutative ring is finitely generated.
Over a Noetherian commutative ring, submodules of finitely generated modules are finitely generated.
The object property on `ModuleCat A` consisting of modules that are finitely generated over `A`.
